subject: Grand Theft Auto VI
title: What time does GTA 6 unlock? Midnight ET Nov. 19, 9 p.m. PT Nov. 18
answer: Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks at midnight local time on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026, according to Rockstar Games. In the U.S., storefronts are expected to follow Eastern time, so players in other time zones can start the evening of Wednesday, Nov. 18: 11 p.m. Central, 10 p.m. Mountain and 9 p.m. Pacific.
in_the_news: Pre-loading opened on Nov. 10 and launch is one week away, so searches for unlock times, download size and PC availability are climbing.
body:
Rockstar's support page says the game "will release midnight local time on November 19, 2026, in all regions." Rockstar has not published its own U.S. breakdown, but reporting by Forbes and others indicates U.S. digital stores key the release to Eastern time. That would mean 11 p.m. Central, 10 p.m. Mountain, 9 p.m. Pacific, 8 p.m. Alaska and 7 p.m. Hawaii on Nov. 18. If your store shows a different time, the store's countdown is the one that counts.

Pre-loading is already open. On PlayStation 5 it started at midnight local time on Nov. 10; on Xbox Series X|S it began at 12 a.m. GMT on Nov. 10, which was 7 p.m. ET on Nov. 9 in the U.S. PlayStation recommends clearing at least 212 GB of storage before downloading, so check free space on your console now rather than on launch night, when servers will be busiest.

The game launches only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not announced a PC version or date, following the pattern of GTA V, which reached PC well after its console debut.

faq.q: Can I play GTA 6 early in the U.S.?
faq.a: Players outside the Eastern time zone may be able to start on the evening of Nov. 18, because U.S. storefronts are expected to unlock at midnight Eastern.

faq.q: How big is the GTA 6 download?
faq.a: PlayStation recommends at least 212 GB of free storage on PS5.
Not at launch. It is releasing on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Rockstar has not announced a PC date.
Nov. 10, 2026, at midnight local time on PS5; on Xbox it began at 12 a.m. GMT Nov. 10 (7 p.m. ET Nov. 9).
